full_judgment: 3. Plaintiffs case, inter alia, is that her father Upendra Nath Paul and her uncle Nripendra Nath Pual being Bangladeshi citizens were the recorded owners of the suit property under both in RS and SA Khatian. Her father by registered deed gift dated 25-3-1975 made a gift of 'Ka' schedule property in her favour and handed over possession thereof; that her uncle Nripendra Nath Paul used to maintain her from her childhood out of love and affection and, as such, he (Nripendra Nath Paul) also by another  registered deed of gift dated 26-6-1975 transferred 'Kha' schedule property in her favour and also handed over the possession thereof. Having received the said property, the plaintiff has been possessing the same. But the defendant No.2 being influenced by some local people started the aforesaid Vested Property Case on the basis of a collusive report from defendant No. 3 the local Circle Officer (Rev) and illegally passed an order on 12-10-1976 in the aforesaid VP Case treating the said property as Vested Property. Hence the suit.
